name: 清华大学
intro: 清华大学坐落于北京西北郊，建于皇家园林清华园遗址之上。水木清华，荷塘月色，是中国最顶尖的综合性研究型大学。
admission: 清华大学坐落于北京西北郊，建于皇家园林清华园遗址之上。水木清华，荷塘月色，是中国最顶尖的综合性研究型大学。学校肇建于1911年，全国综合排名位列第1位，985工程、211工程、双一流建设、C9联盟。学校在计算机科学与技术、电子信息工程、建筑学、经济管理、自动化等学科领域优势显著，形成鲜明的学科特色与办学风格。以「自强不息，厚德载物」为校训，承学脉、育英才，致力于培养德才兼备的栋梁之材。校园人文底蕴深厚，教学科研设施完备，是无数学子求学问道、修身立业的理想之地。
scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、北京市外国留学生奖学金、清华大学新生奖学金（学费+4000元/月）
motto_en: Self-discipline and Social Commitment
intro_en: Tsinghua University is located in the northwestern suburbs of Beijing, on the historic site of the former imperial Qinghua Garden. Renowned for its lotus ponds, shaded walkways, and classical architecture, it stands as China's premier comprehensive research university, excelling in science, engineering, humanities, and management. Founded in 1911, Tsinghua has produced generations of leaders in academia, industry, and government, and ranks consistently among the world's top universities.
admission_en: Tsinghua University is located in the northwestern suburbs of Beijing, on the historic site of the former imperial Qinghua Garden. Renowned for its lotus ponds, shaded walkways, and classical architecture, it stands as China's premier comprehensive research university, excelling in science, engineering, humanities, and management. Founded in 1911, Tsinghua has produced generations of leaders in academia, industry, and government, and ranks consistently among the world's top universities. Based in Beijing (Project 985, Project 211, Double First-Class, C9 League). The university holds distinctive strengths in Computer Science and Technology, Electronic Information Engineering, Architecture, Economics and Management, Automation, fostering a characteristic academic tradition. Guided by the motto "Self-discipline and Social Commitment", the university cultivates talent with integrity and excellence. With deep cultural heritage and well-equipped research facilities, the campus is an ideal place for scholars to learn, grow, and pursue their aspirations.
scholarship_en: Chinese Government Scholarship, Beijing Government Scholarship for International Students, Tsinghua Freshman Scholarship

programs_intro.计算机科学与技术: 培养系统掌握计算机软硬件理论、算法设计与分析、人工智能等核心知识，毕业生可在互联网、金融、智能制造等领域从事研发与管理工作。
programs_intro.电子信息工程: 面向信息产业需求，培养掌握信号处理、嵌入式系统、通信技术的高级人才，核心课程包括电路、数字信号处理、通信原理等，就业面广。
programs_intro.建筑学: 融合工程技术与人文艺术，培养具备建筑设计、城市规划能力的人才，核心课程含建筑设计、建筑历史、城市设计，毕业生多进入设计院和地产企业。
programs_intro.经济管理: 培养掌握现代经济理论和管理方法的高级人才，涵盖微观经济学、宏观经济学、运营管理等课程，毕业生可在金融、咨询、企业管理等领域发展。
programs_intro.自动化: 以控制论为核心，培养工业自动化、机器人、智能制造领域的高级人才，核心课程含自动控制原理、传感器技术、PLC编程等，就业前景广阔。
programs_intro.材料科学与工程: 研究材料组成、结构、性能与加工，培养新材料研发人才，涵盖金属材料、无机非金属、高分子材料等方向，毕业生多进入制造业和科研院所。

programs_intro_en.计算机科学与技术: A comprehensive program covering algorithms, software engineering, AI, and computer systems. Graduates pursue careers at top tech companies, research labs, and startups worldwide.
programs_intro_en.电子信息工程: Focuses on electronic circuits, signal processing, communication systems, and embedded design. Prepares engineers for 5G, IoT, and semiconductor industries.
programs_intro_en.建筑学: Blends artistic design with engineering principles. Students learn architectural history, structural design, and urban planning. Graduates work at leading architecture firms globally.
programs_intro_en.经济管理: A specialized program in Economics and Management, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.自动化: Covers control systems, robotics, industrial automation, and intelligent systems. Graduates drive smart manufacturing and Industry 4.0 transformation.
programs_intro_en.材料科学与工程: Covers metals, ceramics, polymers, nanomaterials, and composite materials. Graduates innovate in aerospace, energy, and advanced manufacturing.

name: 北京大学
intro: 北京大学创立于1898年戊戌变法之际，初名京师大学堂，是中国近现代第一所国立综合性大学。未名湖畔、博雅塔下，文理医工交融。
admission: 北京大学创立于1898年戊戌变法之际，初名京师大学堂，是中国近现代第一所国立综合性大学。未名湖畔、博雅塔下，文理医工交融。学校全国综合排名位列第2位，985工程、211工程、双一流建设、C9联盟。学校在数学、物理学、中国语言文学、法学、经济学等学科领域优势显著，形成鲜明的学科特色与办学风格。以「思想自由，兼容并包」为校训，承学脉、育英才，致力于培养德才兼备的栋梁之材。校园人文底蕴深厚，教学科研设施完备，是无数学子求学问道、修身立业的理想之地。
scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、北京大学外国留学生奖学金、孔子学院奖学金
motto_en: Freedom of Thought, Embracing Diversity
intro_en: Peking University, founded in 1898 during the Hundred Days' Reform, was originally named the Imperial University of Peking. As China's first modern national comprehensive university, it features the iconic Weiming Lake and Boya Pagoda on its historic campus. The university is celebrated for its strengths across humanities, sciences, medicine, and engineering, and has long been a cradle of progressive thought and academic excellence in modern China.
admission_en: Peking University, founded in 1898 during the Hundred Days' Reform, was originally named the Imperial University of Peking. As China's first modern national comprehensive university, it features the iconic Weiming Lake and Boya Pagoda on its historic campus. The university is celebrated for its strengths across humanities, sciences, medicine, and engineering, and has long been a cradle of progressive thought and academic excellence in modern China. Ranked No.2 nationwide, based in Beijing (Project 985, Project 211, Double First-Class, C9 League). The university holds distinctive strengths in Mathematics, Physics, Chinese Language and Literature, Law, Economics, fostering a characteristic academic tradition. Guided by the motto "Freedom of Thought, Embracing Diversity", the university cultivates talent with integrity and excellence. With deep cultural heritage and well-equipped research facilities, the campus is an ideal place for scholars to learn, grow, and pursue their aspirations.
scholarship_en: Chinese Government Scholarship, Peking University Scholarship for International Students, Confucius Institute Scholarship

programs_intro.数学: 培养具有坚实数学基础和逻辑思维能力的人才，核心课程含数学分析、高等代数、拓扑学，毕业生可在教育、金融、数据科学等领域发展。
programs_intro.物理学: 探究物质基本规律，培养具备理论物理和实验物理能力的人才，核心课程含量子力学、电动力学、统计物理，毕业生可从事科研、教育及高新技术产业。
programs_intro.中国语言文学: 深入研究汉语言文字与中国文学，培养具备深厚人文素养的人才，涵盖古代文学、现代文学、语言学等方向，毕业生多从事教育、文化、传媒工作。
programs_intro.法学: 培养系统掌握法律理论和实务技能的专业人才，核心课程含民法、刑法、宪法、国际法，毕业生可从事律师、法官、检察官及企业法务等工作。
programs_intro.经济学: 研究资源配置与经济发展规律，培养具备经济分析和决策能力的人才，涵盖宏观经济学、微观经济学、计量经济学，毕业生多进入金融和政府部门。
programs_intro.哲学: 培养具有批判性思维和深厚理论素养的人才，核心课程含中国哲学、西方哲学、逻辑学、伦理学，毕业生可从事教育、研究、文化管理等工作。
programs_intro.临床医学: 培养具备扎实医学理论和临床技能的医师，核心课程含解剖学、病理学、内科学、外科学，学制五至八年，毕业生进入医院从事临床诊疗工作。

programs_intro_en.数学: A specialized program in Mathematics, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.物理学: Explores fundamental laws of nature from quantum mechanics to cosmology. Graduates pursue research, teaching, and high-tech industry roles globally.
programs_intro_en.中国语言文学: A specialized program in Chinese Language and Literature, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.法学: A comprehensive legal education covering constitutional, civil, criminal, and international law. Graduates become lawyers, judges, legal advisors, and policy makers.
programs_intro_en.经济学: Covers micro/macroeconomics, econometrics, and international trade. Graduates pursue careers in finance, consulting, government, and international organizations.
programs_intro_en.哲学: Engages with fundamental questions of existence, ethics, and knowledge. Develops critical thinking valued in law, consulting, academia, and public service.
programs_intro_en.临床医学: A rigorous program combining theoretical medicine with clinical practice. Students train in affiliated hospitals, developing diagnostic and treatment skills under expert mentorship.

name: 复旦大学
motto: 博学而笃志，切问而近思
intro: 复旦大学位于上海，由马相伯创办于1905年，校名取自《尚书大传》「日月光华，旦复旦兮」。综合性研究型大学，文理医工并重。
admission: 复旦大学位于上海，由马相伯创办于1905年，校名取自《尚书大传》「日月光华，旦复旦兮」。综合性研究型大学，文理医工并重。学校全国综合排名位列第3位，985工程、211工程、双一流建设、C9联盟。学校在新闻传播学、经济学、国际政治、数学、临床医学等学科领域优势显著，形成鲜明的学科特色与办学风格。以「博学而笃志，切问而近思」为校训，承学脉、育英才，致力于培养德才兼备的栋梁之材。校园人文底蕴深厚，教学科研设施完备，是无数学子求学问道、修身立业的理想之地。
scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、上海市外国留学生奖学金、复旦大学新生奖学金
motto_en: Rich in Knowledge and Tenacious of Purposes, Inquiring with Earnestness and Reflecting with Self-Practice
intro_en: Fudan University, located in Shanghai, was founded in 1905 by Ma Xiangbo. Its name, drawn from a classical text, signifies 'heavenly light shines forth day after day.' As a leading comprehensive research university, Fudan excels equally in humanities, sciences, medicine, and engineering, and is renowned for its liberal academic atmosphere and international outlook, attracting scholars and students from around the world.
admission_en: Fudan University, located in Shanghai, was founded in 1905 by Ma Xiangbo. Its name, drawn from a classical text, signifies 'heavenly light shines forth day after day.' As a leading comprehensive research university, Fudan excels equally in humanities, sciences, medicine, and engineering, and is renowned for its liberal academic atmosphere and international outlook, attracting scholars and students from around the world. Guided by the motto "Rich in Knowledge and Tenacious of Purposes, Inquiring with Earnestness and Reflecting with Self-Practice", the university cultivates talent with integrity and excellence. With deep cultural heritage and well-equipped research facilities, the campus is an ideal place for scholars to learn, grow, and pursue their aspirations.
scholarship_en: Chinese Government Scholarship, Shanghai Government Scholarship for International Students, Fudan Freshman Scholarship

programs_intro.新闻传播学: 培养具备新闻采编、传播策划和新媒体运营能力的人才，涵盖新闻采访、传播学理论、媒介经营管理等课程，毕业生多进入媒体和互联网行业。
programs_intro.经济学: 研究资源配置与经济发展规律，培养具备经济分析和决策能力的人才，涵盖宏观经济学、微观经济学、计量经济学，毕业生多进入金融和政府部门。
programs_intro.国际政治: 研究国际关系与全球治理，培养具备国际视野和分析能力的人才，核心课程含国际关系理论、外交学、国际法，毕业生可从事外交、国际组织等工作。
programs_intro.数学: 培养具有坚实数学基础和逻辑思维能力的人才，核心课程含数学分析、高等代数、拓扑学，毕业生可在教育、金融、数据科学等领域发展。
programs_intro.临床医学: 培养具备扎实医学理论和临床技能的医师，核心课程含解剖学、病理学、内科学、外科学，学制五至八年，毕业生进入医院从事临床诊疗工作。
programs_intro.化学: 探究物质组成与变化规律，培养具备化学实验和科研能力的人才，涵盖有机化学、无机化学、物理化学等方向，毕业生可从事科研、化工、制药等工作。

programs_intro_en.新闻传播学: Covers journalism, digital media, public relations, and communication theory. Graduates work in media, corporate communications, and content creation.
programs_intro_en.经济学: Covers micro/macroeconomics, econometrics, and international trade. Graduates pursue careers in finance, consulting, government, and international organizations.
programs_intro_en.国际政治: Focuses on international relations, global governance, and diplomacy. Prepares graduates for careers in foreign service, UN agencies, and global affairs.
programs_intro_en.数学: A specialized program in Mathematics, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.临床医学: A rigorous program combining theoretical medicine with clinical practice. Students train in affiliated hospitals, developing diagnostic and treatment skills under expert mentorship.
programs_intro_en.化学: Covers organic, inorganic, analytical, and physical chemistry with laboratory training. Graduates work in pharmaceuticals, materials science, and environmental protection.

name: 上海交通大学
intro: 上海交通大学创办于1896年，前身为南洋公学，是中国历史最悠久的高等学府之一。工科见长，医学、经管、理科并重。
admission: 上海交通大学创办于1896年，前身为南洋公学，是中国历史最悠久的高等学府之一。工科见长，医学、经管、理科并重。学校全国综合排名位列第4位，985工程、211工程、双一流建设、C9联盟。学校在船舶与海洋工程、机械工程、电子信息、临床医学、工商管理等学科领域优势显著，形成鲜明的学科特色与办学风格。以「饮水思源，爱国荣校」为校训，承学脉、育英才，致力于培养德才兼备的栋梁之材。校园人文底蕴深厚，教学科研设施完备，是无数学子求学问道、修身立业的理想之地。
scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、上海市奖学金、交大外国留学生奖学金
motto_en: When Drinking Water, Think of Its Source; Love the Motherland and Honor the University
intro_en: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, founded in 1896 as Nanyang Public School, is one of China's oldest institutions of higher learning. Renowned for its engineering heritage, the university has expanded into a comprehensive research powerhouse with strengths in medicine, management, and the sciences. Its Minhang and Xuhui campuses are home to cutting-edge laboratories and a vibrant international community.
admission_en: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, founded in 1896 as Nanyang Public School, is one of China's oldest institutions of higher learning. Renowned for its engineering heritage, the university has expanded into a comprehensive research powerhouse with strengths in medicine, management, and the sciences. Its Minhang and Xuhui campuses are home to cutting-edge laboratories and a vibrant international community. Ranked No.4 nationwide, based in Shanghai (Project 985, Project 211, Double First-Class, C9 League). The university holds distinctive strengths in Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronic Information, Clinical Medicine, Business Administration, fostering a characteristic academic tradition. Guided by the motto "When Drinking Water, Think of Its Source; Love the Motherland and Honor the University", the university cultivates talent with integrity and excellence. With deep cultural heritage and well-equipped research facilities, the campus is an ideal place for scholars to learn, grow, and pursue their aspirations.
scholarship_en: Chinese Government Scholarship, Shanghai Municipal Government Scholarship, SJTU International Student Scholarship

programs_intro.船舶与海洋工程: 面向海洋强国战略，培养船舶与海洋平台设计制造人才，核心课程含船舶结构力学、海洋工程、流体力学，毕业生多进入造船企业和海洋研究机构。
programs_intro.机械工程: 培养掌握机械设计、制造和自动化技术的高级人才，核心课程含机械原理、机械设计、制造技术基础，毕业生在装备制造、汽车、航空航天等领域就业。
programs_intro.电子信息: 融合电子技术与信息技术，培养集成电路、通信系统领域人才，涵盖电路设计、信号处理、嵌入式系统等课程，毕业生在电子信息产业广泛就业。
programs_intro.临床医学: 培养具备扎实医学理论和临床技能的医师，核心课程含解剖学、病理学、内科学、外科学，学制五至八年，毕业生进入医院从事临床诊疗工作。
programs_intro.工商管理: 培养具备企业管理、市场营销、财务管理能力的综合型人才，核心课程含管理学原理、运营管理、战略管理，毕业生可进入各类企业和咨询机构。
programs_intro.材料科学: 研究材料组成、结构、性能与加工，培养新材料研发人才，涵盖金属材料、无机非金属、高分子材料等方向，毕业生多进入制造业和科研院所。

programs_intro_en.船舶与海洋工程: Covers naval architecture, marine engineering, and offshore structures. Graduates design ships, submarines, and offshore platforms.
programs_intro_en.机械工程: Encompasses mechanical design, robotics, manufacturing, and thermal engineering. Graduates lead innovation in automotive, aerospace, and industrial automation.
programs_intro_en.电子信息: A specialized program in Electronic Information, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.临床医学: A rigorous program combining theoretical medicine with clinical practice. Students train in affiliated hospitals, developing diagnostic and treatment skills under expert mentorship.
programs_intro_en.工商管理: Covers strategy, marketing, operations, and organizational behavior. Prepares future business leaders for multinational corporations and entrepreneurship.
programs_intro_en.材料科学: A specialized program in Materials Science and Engineering, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.

name: 浙江大学
intro: 浙江大学坐落于杭州西湖之畔，前身为求是书院，创立于1897年，是中国人最早自己创办的新式高等学校之一。
admission: 浙江大学坐落于杭州西湖之畔，前身为求是书院，创立于1897年，是中国人最早自己创办的新式高等学校之一。学校全国综合排名位列第5位，985工程、211工程、双一流建设、C9联盟。学校在光学工程、计算机科学与技术、控制科学与工程、农林经济管理、机械工程等学科领域优势显著，形成鲜明的学科特色与办学风格。以「求是创新」为校训，承学脉、育英才，致力于培养德才兼备的栋梁之材。校园人文底蕴深厚，教学科研设施完备，是无数学子求学问道、修身立业的理想之地。
scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、浙江省外国留学生奖学金、浙大新生奖学金

intro_en: Zhejiang University, situated by the scenic West Lake in Hangzhou, traces its origins to Qiushi Academy, founded in 1897. As one of China's earliest modern institutions of higher learning established by Chinese educators, it has grown into a comprehensive research university with distinctive strengths across engineering, agriculture, medicine, sciences, and the humanities.
admission_en: Zhejiang University, situated by the scenic West Lake in Hangzhou, traces its origins to Qiushi Academy, founded in 1897. name: 南京大学
intro: 南京大学始于1902年的三江师范学堂，是中国现代科学的发祥地之一。仙林校区银杏成林，鼓楼校区古朴雅致。

scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、江苏省茉莉花奖学金、南大留学生奖学金
motto_en: Sincere with Majesty, Diligent in Study and Practice
intro_en: Nanjing University traces its roots to Sanjiang Normal School, established in 1902, and is recognized as a cradle of modern Chinese science. Its Xianlin campus is known for ginkgo-lined avenues, while the historic Gulou campus exudes classical charm. The university is celebrated for its strengths in astronomy, geology, physics, and Chinese language and literature.
admission_en: Nanjing University traces its roots to Sanjiang Normal School, established in 1902, and is recognized as a cradle of modern Chinese science. Its Xianlin campus is known for ginkgo-lined avenues, while the historic Gulou campus exudes classical charm. name: 天津大学
intro: 天津大学前身为北洋大学，创办于1895年，是中国第一所现代大学。工科见长，建筑、化工、机械国内领先。
admission: 天津大学前身为北洋大学，创办于1895年，是中国第一所现代大学。工科见长，建筑、化工、机械国内领先。学校全国综合排名位列第15位，985工程、211工程、双一流建设。学校在建筑学、化学工程、机械工程、仪器科学与技术、光学工程等学科领域优势显著，形成鲜明的学科特色与办学风格。以「实事求是」为校训，承学脉、育英才，致力于培养德才兼备的栋梁之材。校园人文底蕴深厚，教学科研设施完备，是无数学子求学问道、修身立业的理想之地。
scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、天津市奖学金、天大留学生奖学金
motto_en: Seeking Truth from Facts
intro_en: Tianjin University, formerly Peiyang University, was founded in 1895 and holds the distinction of being China's first modern university. Renowned for its engineering heritage, the university leads the nation in architecture, chemical engineering, and mechanical engineering, and continues to drive innovation in science and technology education.
admission_en: Tianjin University, formerly Peiyang University, was founded in 1895 and holds the distinction of being China's first modern university. Renowned for its engineering heritage, the university leads the nation in architecture, chemical engineering, and mechanical engineering, and continues to drive innovation in science and technology education. Ranked No.15 nationwide, based in Tianjin (Project 985, Project 211, Double First-Class). The university holds distinctive strengths in Architecture, Chemistry, Mechanical Engineering, Instrument Science and Technology, Optical Engineering, fostering a characteristic academic tradition. Guided by the motto "Seeking Truth from Facts", the university cultivates talent with integrity and excellence. With deep cultural heritage and well-equipped research facilities, the campus is an ideal place for scholars to learn, grow, and pursue their aspirations.
scholarship_en: Chinese Government Scholarship, Tianjin Municipal Government Scholarship, TJU International Student Scholarship

programs_intro.建筑学: 融合工程技术与人文艺术，培养具备建筑设计、城市规划能力的人才，核心课程含建筑设计、建筑历史、城市设计，毕业生多进入设计院和地产企业。
programs_intro.化学工程: 探究物质组成与变化规律，培养具备化学实验和科研能力的人才，涵盖有机化学、无机化学、物理化学等方向，毕业生可从事科研、化工、制药等工作。
programs_intro.机械工程: 培养掌握机械设计、制造和自动化技术的高级人才，核心课程含机械原理、机械设计、制造技术基础，毕业生在装备制造、汽车、航空航天等领域就业。
programs_intro.仪器科学与技术: 培养精密仪器设计人才，核心课程含传感器技术、测控电路、精密测量、仪器智能化，毕业生在仪器仪表和自动化企业工作。
programs_intro.光学工程: 研究光学理论及应用技术，培养光电信息、激光技术领域人才，核心课程含物理光学、激光原理、光学设计，毕业生在光电产业和科研院所就业。
programs_intro.材料科学: 研究材料组成、结构、性能与加工，培养新材料研发人才，涵盖金属材料、无机非金属、高分子材料等方向，毕业生多进入制造业和科研院所。

programs_intro_en.建筑学: Blends artistic design with engineering principles. Students learn architectural history, structural design, and urban planning. Graduates work at leading architecture firms globally.
programs_intro_en.化学工程: Covers chemical processes, reactor design, and industrial chemistry. Graduates work in petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, and materials manufacturing.
programs_intro_en.机械工程: Encompasses mechanical design, robotics, manufacturing, and thermal engineering. Graduates lead innovation in automotive, aerospace, and industrial automation.
programs_intro_en.仪器科学与技术: A specialized program in Instrument Science and Technology, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.光学工程: A specialized program in Optical Engineering, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.材料科学: A specialized program in Materials Science and Engineering, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.

name: 同济大学
intro: 同济大学由德国医生埃里希·宝隆于1907年创办，前身为德文医学堂。土木建筑享誉全国，樱花园春日游人如织。
admission: 同济大学由德国医生埃里希·宝隆于1907年创办，前身为德文医学堂。土木建筑享誉全国，樱花园春日游人如织。学校全国综合排名位列第16位，985工程、211工程、双一流建设。学校在土木工程、建筑学、城乡规划学、交通运输工程、环境科学与工程等学科领域优势显著，形成鲜明的学科特色与办学风格。以「同舟共济，自强不息」为校训，承学脉、育英才，致力于培养德才兼备的栋梁之材。校园人文底蕴深厚，教学科研设施完备，是无数学子求学问道、修身立业的理想之地。
scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、上海市奖学金、同济留学生奖学金
motto_en: Solidarity in Adversity, Self-Improvement
intro_en: Tongji University, founded in 1907 by German physician Erich Paulun, originated as a German medical school. It is nationally renowned for civil engineering and architecture, and its cherry blossom gardens attract visitors each spring. The university has grown into a comprehensive institution with distinctive Sino-German educational traditions.
admission_en: Tongji University, founded in 1907 by German physician Erich Paulun, originated as a German medical school. It is nationally renowned for civil engineering and architecture, and its cherry blossom gardens attract visitors each spring. The university has grown into a comprehensive institution with distinctive Sino-German educational traditions. Ranked No.16 nationwide, based in Shanghai (Project 985, Project 211, Double First-Class). The university holds distinctive strengths in Civil Engineering (Roads and Bridges), Architecture, Urban and Rural Planning, Transportation Engineering, Environmental Science and Engineering, fostering a characteristic academic tradition. Guided by the motto "Solidarity in Adversity, Self-Improvement", the university cultivates talent with integrity and excellence. With deep cultural heritage and well-equipped research facilities, the campus is an ideal place for scholars to learn, grow, and pursue their aspirations.
scholarship_en: Chinese Government Scholarship, Shanghai Municipal Government Scholarship, Tongji International Student Scholarship

programs_intro.城乡规划学: 培养城乡规划设计人才，核心课程含城市规划原理、城市设计、区域规划、村镇规划，毕业生在规划院和城建部门工作。
programs_intro.交通运输工程: 培养交通系统规划运营人才，核心课程含交通运输学、交通规划、交通工程设计、物流工程，毕业生在交通部门和运输企业工作。
programs_intro.环境科学与工程: 培养环境科学和工程人才，核心课程含环境化学、环境生物学、环境工程学、环境监测，毕业生在环保企业和科研机构工作。

programs_intro_en.土木工程: Covers structural engineering, bridge design, geotechnics, and construction management. Prepares engineers for major infrastructure projects worldwide.
programs_intro_en.建筑学: Blends artistic design with engineering principles. Students learn architectural history, structural design, and urban planning. Graduates work at leading architecture firms globally.
programs_intro_en.城乡规划学: A specialized program in Urban and Rural Planning, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.交通运输工程: A specialized program in Transportation Engineering, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.环境科学与工程: A specialized program in Environmental Science and Engineering, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.车辆工程: A specialized program in Vehicle Engineering, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.

name: 厦门大学
intro: 厦门大学由陈嘉庚先生于1921年创办，是中国近代教育史上第一所华侨创办的大学。依山傍海，被誉为「中国最美大学」。

scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、福建省奖学金、厦大留学生奖学金
motto_en: Self-Improvement, Pursuit of Perfection
intro_en: Xiamen University, founded in 1921 by Tan Kah Kee, a prominent overseas Chinese philanthropist, was the first university established by an overseas Chinese entrepreneur. Nestled between mountains and the sea, it is widely regarded as one of China's most beautiful campuses, and is renowned for accounting, economics, chemistry, and marine science.
admission_en: Xiamen University, founded in 1921 by Tan Kah Kee, a prominent overseas Chinese philanthropist, was the first university established by an overseas Chinese entrepreneur. Nestled between mountains and the sea, it is widely regarded as one of China's most beautiful campuses, and is renowned for accounting, economics, chemistry, and marine science. Ranked No.17 nationwide, based in Fujian (Project 985, Project 211, Double First-Class). The university holds distinctive strengths in Accounting, Economics, Chemistry, Marine Science, Statistics, fostering a characteristic academic tradition. Guided by the motto "Self-Improvement, Pursuit of Perfection", the university cultivates talent with integrity and excellence. With deep cultural heritage and well-equipped research facilities, the campus is an ideal place for scholars to learn, grow, and pursue their aspirations.
scholarship_en: Chinese Government Scholarship, Fujian Provincial Government Scholarship, XMU International Student Scholarship

programs_intro.会计学: 培养系统掌握会计理论和实务技能的专业人才，核心课程含财务会计、管理会计、审计学、税法，毕业生多进入会计师事务所和企业财务部门。
programs_intro.经济学: 研究资源配置与经济发展规律，培养具备经济分析和决策能力的人才，涵盖宏观经济学、微观经济学、计量经济学，毕业生多进入金融和政府部门。
programs_intro.化学: 探究物质组成与变化规律，培养具备化学实验和科研能力的人才，涵盖有机化学、无机化学、物理化学等方向，毕业生可从事科研、化工、制药等工作。
programs_intro.海洋科学: 海洋科学专业培养具备扎实理论基础和较强实践能力的高级专门人才，核心课程涵盖学科前沿理论与技术，毕业生可在相关行业从事技术研发、管理和研究工作。
programs_intro.统计学: 培养具备数据分析和统计推断能力的人才，核心课程含概率论、数理统计、回归分析、时间序列，毕业生在金融、互联网、市场研究等领域广泛就业。
programs_intro.广告学: 培养广告策划和创意人才，核心课程含广告学概论、广告策划、广告创意、广告媒体，毕业生在广告公司和媒体广告部工作。

programs_intro_en.会计学: Covers financial reporting, auditing, taxation, and management accounting. Graduates become CPAs and financial professionals at top firms.
programs_intro_en.经济学: Covers micro/macroeconomics, econometrics, and international trade. Graduates pursue careers in finance, consulting, government, and international organizations.
programs_intro_en.化学: Covers organic, inorganic, analytical, and physical chemistry with laboratory training. Graduates work in pharmaceuticals, materials science, and environmental protection.
programs_intro_en.海洋科学: Explores oceanography, marine biology, and marine resources. Graduates contribute to marine conservation, resource management, and climate science.
programs_intro_en.统计学: Covers probability theory, statistical inference, and data analysis. Graduates excel in finance, insurance, biostatistics, and data science.
programs_intro_en.广告学: A specialized program in Advertising, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.

name: 东南大学
intro: 东南大学坐落于南京，前身可追溯到1902年三江师范学堂。工科见长，建筑、电子、交通国内顶尖。
admission: 东南大学坐落于南京，前身可追溯到1902年三江师范学堂。工科见长，建筑、电子、交通国内顶尖。学校全国综合排名位列第18位，985工程、211工程、双一流建设。学校在建筑学、电子科学与技术、信息与通信工程、交通运输工程、生物医学工程等学科领域优势显著，形成鲜明的学科特色与办学风格。以「止于至善」为校训，承学脉、育英才，致力于培养德才兼备的栋梁之材。校园人文底蕴深厚，教学科研设施完备，是无数学子求学问道、修身立业的理想之地。
scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、江苏省奖学金、SEU留学生奖学金

intro_en: Southeast University, located in Nanjing, traces its origins to Sanjiang Normal School, established in 1902. The university is renowned for its engineering excellence, particularly in architecture, electronic science, and transportation engineering, and is a leading comprehensive research institution with a rich academic heritage.
admission_en: Southeast University, located in Nanjing, traces its origins to Sanjiang Normal School, established in 1902. name: 北京航空航天大学
intro: 北京航空航天大学创建于1952年，是新中国第一所航空航天高等学府。航空航天、计算机、仪器科学国内领先。

scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、北京市奖学金、北航留学生奖学金
motto_en: Virtue and Talent Combined, Unity of Knowledge and Action
intro_en: Beihang University, founded in 1952, was New China's first institution of higher learning dedicated to aeronautics and astronautics. The university leads the nation in aerospace, computer science, and instrumentation, and has played a pivotal role in China's aviation and space programs, cultivating generations of aerospace engineers.
admission_en: Beihang University, founded in 1952, was New China's first institution of higher learning dedicated to aeronautics and astronautics. The university leads the nation in aerospace, computer science, and instrumentation, and has played a pivotal role in China's aviation and space programs, cultivating generations of aerospace engineers. Ranked No.19 nationwide, based in Beijing (Project 985, Project 211, Double First-Class). Guided by the motto "Virtue and Talent Combined, Unity of Knowledge and Action", the university cultivates talent with integrity and excellence. programs_intro.计算机科学与技术: 培养系统掌握计算机软硬件理论、算法设计与分析、人工智能等核心知识，毕业生可在互联网、金融、智能制造等领域从事研发与管理工作。
programs_intro.仪器科学与技术: 培养精密仪器设计人才，核心课程含传感器技术、测控电路、精密测量、仪器智能化，毕业生在仪器仪表和自动化企业工作。

programs_intro.材料科学与工程: 研究材料组成、结构、性能与加工，培养新材料研发人才，涵盖金属材料、无机非金属、高分子材料等方向，毕业生多进入制造业和科研院所。

programs_intro_en.仪器科学与技术: A specialized program in Instrument Science and Technology, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.

name: 中国农业大学
motto: 解民生之多艰，育天下之英才
intro: 中国农业大学前身为1905年成立的京师大学堂农科大学，是中国现代农业高等教育的起源地。农学、生命科学见长。

scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、北京市奖学金、CAU留学生奖学金
motto_en: Relieve the Hardships of the People, Cultivate the Talents of the World
intro_en: China Agricultural University, originating from the agricultural college of the Imperial University of Peking in 1905, is the birthplace of modern agricultural higher education in China. The university leads the nation in agricultural science and life sciences, with distinctive strengths in crop science, agricultural engineering, and veterinary medicine.
admission_en: China Agricultural University, originating from the agricultural college of the Imperial University of Peking in 1905, is the birthplace of modern agricultural higher education in China. The university leads the nation in agricultural science and life sciences, with distinctive strengths in crop science, agricultural engineering, and veterinary medicine. With deep cultural heritage and well-equipped research facilities, the campus is an ideal place for scholars to learn, grow, and pursue their aspirations.
scholarship_en: Chinese Government Scholarship, Beijing Municipal Government Scholarship, CAU International Student Scholarship

programs_intro.农业资源与环境: 培养农业资源高效利用和环境保护人才，核心课程含土壤学、植物营养学、环境监测，毕业生在农业、环保、国土等部门就业。

Known as the 'cradle of petroleum technology talent,' the university leads the nation in petroleum engineering and geological resources, supporting China's energy security.
admission_en: China University of Petroleum (Beijing), founded in 1953, was New China's first petroleum institution of higher learning. Known as the 'cradle of petroleum technology talent,' the university leads the nation in petroleum engineering and geological resources, supporting China's energy security. Ranked No.60 nationwide, based in Beijing (Project 211, Double First-Class). The university holds distinctive strengths in Petroleum Engineering, Oil and Gas Storage and Transportation Engineering, Geological Resources and Geological Engineering, Chemistry, Mechanical Engineering, fostering a characteristic academic tradition. Guided by the motto "Accumulate Strength, Unlock the Potential of Things", the university cultivates talent with integrity and excellence. With deep cultural heritage and well-equipped research facilities, the campus is an ideal place for scholars to learn, grow, and pursue their aspirations.
scholarship_en: Chinese Government Scholarship, Beijing Municipal Government Scholarship, CUP International Student Scholarship

programs_intro.石油工程: 培养油气田开发人才，核心课程含油藏工程、钻井工程、采油工程、油田化学，毕业生在石油企业和油气田研究院工作。
programs_intro.油气储运工程: 培养油气管输和储存人才，核心课程含输油管道设计、输气管道设计、油库设计与管理，毕业生在管道公司和石化企业工作。
programs_intro.地质资源与地质工程: 培养地质资源勘查和工程人才，涵盖矿产资源勘查、地质工程、地球探测技术等方向，毕业生在地质矿产和工程建设领域就业。
programs_intro.化学工程: 探究物质组成与变化规律，培养具备化学实验和科研能力的人才，涵盖有机化学、无机化学、物理化学等方向，毕业生可从事科研、化工、制药等工作。
programs_intro.机械工程: 培养掌握机械设计、制造和自动化技术的高级人才，核心课程含机械原理、机械设计、制造技术基础，毕业生在装备制造、汽车、航空航天等领域就业。
programs_intro.安全工程: 培养安全科学与管理人才，核心课程含安全学原理、安全系统工程、安全人机工程、灾害防治，毕业生在应急管理、安全生产监管等领域就业。

programs_en: Oil and Gas Storage and Transportation Engineering

programs_intro_en.石油工程: A specialized program in Petroleum Engineering, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.油气储运工程: A specialized program in Oil and Gas Storage and Transportation Engineering, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.地质资源与地质工程: A specialized program in Geological Resources and Geological Engineering, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.化学工程: Covers chemical processes, reactor design, and industrial chemistry. Graduates work in petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, and materials manufacturing.
programs_intro_en.机械工程: Encompasses mechanical design, robotics, manufacturing, and thermal engineering. Graduates lead innovation in automotive, aerospace, and industrial automation.
programs_intro_en.安全工程: Covers industrial safety, risk assessment, and emergency management. Graduates ensure workplace and public safety across industries.

name: 中国地质大学（北京）
intro: 中国地质大学（北京）前身为北京地质学院，1952年建校，是地质类学科的顶尖学府。地质学、资源勘查等学科世界知名。
admission: 中国地质大学（北京）前身为北京地质学院，1952年建校，是地质类学科的顶尖学府。地质学、资源勘查等学科世界知名。学校全国综合排名位列第70位，211工程、双一流建设。学校在地质学、资源勘查工程、地球物理学、宝石及材料工艺学、水文与水资源工程等学科领域优势显著，形成鲜明的学科特色与办学风格。以「艰苦朴素，求真务实」为校训，承学脉、育英才，致力于培养德才兼备的栋梁之材。校园人文底蕴深厚，教学科研设施完备，是无数学子求学问道、修身立业的理想之地。
scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、北京市奖学金、CUGB留学生奖学金
motto_en: Plain Living, Hard Work, Seek Truth, Be Practical
intro_en: China University of Geosciences (Beijing), formerly Beijing Institute of Geology, was founded in 1952 and is a top institution for geological sciences. The university is renowned worldwide for its strengths in geology and resource exploration, and has produced many distinguished geoscientists.
admission_en: China University of Geosciences (Beijing), formerly Beijing Institute of Geology, was founded in 1952 and is a top institution for geological sciences. The university is renowned worldwide for its strengths in geology and resource exploration, and has produced many distinguished geoscientists. Ranked No.70 nationwide, based in Beijing (Project 211, Double First-Class). The university holds distinctive strengths in Geology, Resource Exploration Engineering, Geophysics, Gemology and Materials Technology, Hydrology and Water Resources Engineering, fostering a characteristic academic tradition. Guided by the motto "Plain Living, Hard Work, Seek Truth, Be Practical", the university cultivates talent with integrity and excellence. With deep cultural heritage and well-equipped research facilities, the campus is an ideal place for scholars to learn, grow, and pursue their aspirations.
scholarship_en: Chinese Government Scholarship, Beijing Municipal Government Scholarship, CUGB International Student Scholarship

programs_intro.地质学: 研究地球物质组成与演化历史，培养地质调查和资源勘探人才，涵盖矿物学、岩石学、构造地质学等课程，毕业生在地质调查、矿业、能源等领域就业。
programs_intro.资源勘查工程: 资源勘查工程专业培养具备扎实理论基础和较强实践能力的高级专门人才，核心课程涵盖学科前沿理论与技术，毕业生可在相关行业从事技术研发、管理和研究工作。
programs_intro.地球物理学: 运用物理方法研究地球内部结构，培养地震学、重力学、地磁学人才，毕业生在资源勘探、防灾减灾、环境保护等领域就业。
programs_intro.宝石及材料工艺学: 培养宝石鉴定和加工人才，核心课程含宝石学、宝石鉴定、宝石加工、珠宝营销，毕业生在珠宝企业和质检机构工作。
programs_intro.水文与水资源工程: 培养水资源评价和利用人才，核心课程含水文学原理、水文地质学、水资源评价、水灾害防治，毕业生在水利和水资源管理部门工作。
programs_intro.测绘工程: 培养地理空间数据采集和处理人才，核心课程含数字测图原理、GPS原理、遥感原理、GIS工程，毕业生在测绘、规划和自然资源部门工作。

programs_intro_en.地质学: Studies Earth's materials, structures, and processes. Graduates work in mineral exploration, environmental geology, and geotechnical engineering.
programs_intro_en.资源勘查工程: A specialized program in Resource Exploration Engineering, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.地球物理学: Explores Earth's interior structure, seismic activity, and geophysical exploration. Graduates work in resource exploration, earthquake monitoring, and research.
programs_intro_en.宝石及材料工艺学: A specialized program in Gemology and Materials Technology, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.水文与水资源工程: A specialized program in Hydrology and Water Resources Engineering, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.测绘工程: Covers geodesy, remote sensing, GIS, and satellite positioning. Graduates work in mapping, urban planning, and environmental monitoring.

name: 中国政法大学
name_en: China University of Political Science and Law
intro: 中国政法大学创建于1952年，被誉为中国法学教育的最高学府。法学学科全国第一，政治学、社会学等学科优势突出。
admission: 中国政法大学创建于1952年，被誉为中国法学教育的最高学府。法学学科全国第一，政治学、社会学等学科优势突出。学校全国综合排名位列第50位，211工程、双一流建设。学校在法学、政治学与行政学、社会学、经济学、新闻学等学科领域优势显著，形成鲜明的学科特色与办学风格。以「厚德明法，格物致公」为校训，承学脉、育英才，致力于培养德才兼备的栋梁之材。校园人文底蕴深厚，教学科研设施完备，是无数学子求学问道、修身立业的理想之地。
scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、北京市奖学金、CUPL留学生奖学金
motto_en: Cultivate Virtue, Understand Law; Investigate Things, Serve the Public
intro_en: China University of Political Science and Law, founded in 1952, is widely regarded as the premier institution for legal education in China. The university ranks first nationally in law, and is renowned for its strengths in political science and sociology, producing many of China's top jurists and legal scholars.
admission_en: China University of Political Science and Law, founded in 1952, is widely regarded as the premier institution for legal education in China. The university ranks first nationally in law, and is renowned for its strengths in political science and sociology, producing many of China's top jurists and legal scholars. Based in Beijing (Project 211, Double First-Class). The university holds distinctive strengths in Law, Political Science and Administration, Sociology, Economics, Journalism, fostering a characteristic academic tradition. Guided by the motto "Cultivate Virtue, Understand Law; Investigate Things, Serve the Public", the university cultivates talent with integrity and excellence. With deep cultural heritage and well-equipped research facilities, the campus is an ideal place for scholars to learn, grow, and pursue their aspirations.
scholarship_en: Chinese Government Scholarship, Beijing Municipal Government Scholarship, CUPL International Student Scholarship

programs_intro.法学: 培养系统掌握法律理论和实务技能的专业人才，核心课程含民法、刑法、宪法、国际法，毕业生可从事律师、法官、检察官及企业法务等工作。
programs_intro.政治学与行政学: 培养政治理论和行政管理人才，核心课程含政治学原理、行政管理学、公共政策、中国政治制度，毕业生在党政机关和事业单位工作。
programs_intro.社会学: 培养具备社会调查与分析能力的人才，核心课程含社会学概论、社会研究方法、社会心理学，毕业生可在政府、NGO、市场研究等领域工作。
programs_intro.经济学: 研究资源配置与经济发展规律，培养具备经济分析和决策能力的人才，涵盖宏观经济学、微观经济学、计量经济学，毕业生多进入金融和政府部门。
programs_intro.新闻学: 培养具备新闻采写编评能力的专业人才，核心课程含新闻采访、新闻写作、新闻编辑、新闻评论，毕业生多进入报社、电视台和新媒体平台。
programs_intro.国际政治: 研究国际关系与全球治理，培养具备国际视野和分析能力的人才，核心课程含国际关系理论、外交学、国际法，毕业生可从事外交、国际组织等工作。

programs_intro_en.法学: A comprehensive legal education covering constitutional, civil, criminal, and international law. Graduates become lawyers, judges, legal advisors, and policy makers.
programs_intro_en.政治学与行政学: A specialized program in Political Science and Administration, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.社会学: Studies social structures, inequality, and cultural dynamics. Graduates work in research, social policy, NGOs, and international development.
programs_intro_en.经济学: Covers micro/macroeconomics, econometrics, and international trade. Graduates pursue careers in finance, consulting, government, and international organizations.
programs_intro_en.新闻学: A specialized program in Journalism, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.国际政治: Focuses on international relations, global governance, and diplomacy. Prepares graduates for careers in foreign service, UN agencies, and global affairs.

name: 中央戏剧学院
intro: 中央戏剧学院始建于1950年，是新中国第一所戏剧教育高等学校，被誉为「戏剧家的摇篮」。戏剧影视学科全国领先。
admission: 中央戏剧学院始建于1950年，是新中国第一所戏剧教育高等学校，被誉为「戏剧家的摇篮」。戏剧影视学科全国领先。学校全国综合排名位列第150位，211工程、双一流建设。学校在表演、导演、戏剧影视文学、戏剧影视美术设计、播音与主持艺术等学科领域优势显著，形成鲜明的学科特色与办学风格。以「求真创造至美」为校训，承学脉、育英才，致力于培养德才兼备的栋梁之材。校园人文底蕴深厚，教学科研设施完备，是无数学子求学问道、修身立业的理想之地。
scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、北京市奖学金、CAD留学生奖学金
motto_en: Seek Truth, Create Beauty
intro_en: The Central Academy of Drama, founded in 1950, was New China's first institution of higher education for theatre. Widely acclaimed as the 'cradle of dramatists,' the university leads the nation in theatre and film studies, and has produced many of China's most celebrated actors and directors.
admission_en: The Central Academy of Drama, founded in 1950, was New China's first institution of higher education for theatre. Widely acclaimed as the 'cradle of dramatists,' the university leads the nation in theatre and film studies, and has produced many of China's most celebrated actors and directors. Ranked No.150 nationwide, based in Beijing (Project 211, Double First-Class). The university holds distinctive strengths in Acting, Directing, Dramatic and Film Literature, Dramatic and Film Stage Design, Broadcasting and Hosting Art, fostering a characteristic academic tradition. Guided by the motto "Seek Truth, Create Beauty", the university cultivates talent with integrity and excellence. With deep cultural heritage and well-equipped research facilities, the campus is an ideal place for scholars to learn, grow, and pursue their aspirations.
scholarship_en: Chinese Government Scholarship, Beijing Municipal Government Scholarship, CAD International Student Scholarship

programs_intro.表演: 培养戏剧影视表演人才，核心课程含表演基础、台词、形体、声乐、剧目排练，毕业生在剧院、影视制作公司和演艺机构工作。
programs_intro.导演: 培养戏剧影视导演人才，核心课程含导演基础、剧作、视听语言、舞台调度、导演创作，毕业生在剧院、电视台和影视公司从事导演工作。
programs_intro.戏剧影视文学: 培养戏剧影视编剧人才，核心课程含剧作基础、戏剧创作、影视剧本创作、戏剧理论，毕业生在影视公司和剧院从事编剧工作。
programs_intro.戏剧影视美术设计: 培养舞台和影视美术设计人才，核心课程含舞台设计、灯光设计、服装设计、化妆设计，毕业生在剧院和影视制作公司工作。
programs_intro.播音与主持艺术: 培养播音主持人才，核心课程含播音发声、普通话语音、广播播音、电视主持、即兴口语，毕业生在电视台、广播电台和新媒体平台工作。
programs_intro.戏剧学: 培养戏剧理论和研究人才，核心课程含戏剧理论、戏剧史、戏剧批评、剧本分析，毕业生在高校、研究院所和文化机构从事研究工作。

programs_intro_en.表演: A specialized program in Acting, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.导演: A specialized program in Directing, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.戏剧影视文学: A specialized program in Dramatic and Film Literature, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.戏剧影视美术设计: A specialized program in Dramatic and Film Stage Design, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.播音与主持艺术: A specialized program in Broadcasting and Hosting Art, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.戏剧学: A specialized program in Drama Studies, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.

name: 中央美术学院
intro: 中央美术学院成立于1918年，是中国最高美术学府。美术学、设计学等学科全国第一，培养了大量艺术大师。
admission: 中央美术学院成立于1918年，是中国最高美术学府。美术学、设计学等学科全国第一，培养了大量艺术大师。学校全国综合排名位列第150位，211工程、双一流建设。学校在中国画、油画、雕塑、视觉传达设计、建筑学等学科领域优势显著，形成鲜明的学科特色与办学风格。以「尽精微，致广大」为校训，承学脉、育英才，致力于培养德才兼备的栋梁之材。校园人文底蕴深厚，教学科研设施完备，是无数学子求学问道、修身立业的理想之地。
scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、北京市奖学金、CAFA留学生奖学金
motto_en: Attend to the Minutest Details, Achieve the Grandest Vision
intro_en: The Central Academy of Fine Arts, founded in 1918, is China's premier institution for fine arts education. The university ranks first nationally in fine arts and design, and has cultivated generations of master artists who have shaped the course of modern and contemporary Chinese art.
admission_en: The Central Academy of Fine Arts, founded in 1918, is China's premier institution for fine arts education. The university ranks first nationally in fine arts and design, and has cultivated generations of master artists who have shaped the course of modern and contemporary Chinese art. Based in Beijing (Project 211, Double First-Class). The university holds distinctive strengths in Chinese Painting, Oil Painting, Sculpture, Visual Communication Design, Architecture, fostering a characteristic academic tradition. Guided by the motto "Attend to the Minutest Details, Achieve the Grandest Vision", the university cultivates talent with integrity and excellence. With deep cultural heritage and well-equipped research facilities, the campus is an ideal place for scholars to learn, grow, and pursue their aspirations.
scholarship_en: Chinese Government Scholarship, Beijing Municipal Government Scholarship, CAFA International Student Scholarship

programs_intro.中国画: 培养中国画创作人才，核心课程含人物画、山水画、花鸟画、书法篆刻，毕业生在艺术院校、画院和文化机构从事创作和教学工作。
programs_intro.油画: 培养油画创作人才，核心课程含素描、色彩、油画静物、油画人体、创作，毕业生在艺术院校、画院和画廊从事创作和教学工作。
programs_intro.雕塑: 培养雕塑创作人才，核心课程含泥塑、金属雕塑、石雕、木雕、环境雕塑，毕业生在城市规划部门和艺术机构从事雕塑创作工作。
programs_intro.视觉传达设计: 培养平面设计和视觉传达人才，核心课程含版式设计、标志设计、包装设计、广告设计、品牌设计，毕业生在设计公司和广告公司就业。
programs_intro.建筑学: 融合工程技术与人文艺术，培养具备建筑设计、城市规划能力的人才，核心课程含建筑设计、建筑历史、城市设计，毕业生多进入设计院和地产企业。
programs_intro.美术学: 培养美术研究和创作人才，核心课程含中国美术史、西方美术史、美术理论、绘画创作，毕业生在美术馆、画廊和艺术院校工作。

programs_intro_en.中国画: A specialized program in Chinese Painting, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.油画: A specialized program in Oil Painting, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.雕塑: A specialized program in Sculpture, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.视觉传达设计: A specialized program in Visual Communication Design, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.建筑学: Blends artistic design with engineering principles. Students learn architectural history, structural design, and urban planning. Graduates work at leading architecture firms globally.
programs_intro_en.美术学: Covers painting, sculpture, calligraphy, and visual arts theory. Graduates become artists, designers, curators, and art educators.

name: 东华大学
intro: 东华大学创建于1951年，前身为中国纺织大学，是中国纺织高等教育的发源地。纺织科学与工程全国第一，材料、设计学科优势突出。
admission: 东华大学创建于1951年，前身为中国纺织大学，是中国纺织高等教育的发源地。纺织科学与工程全国第一，材料、设计学科优势突出。学校全国综合排名位列第70位，211工程、双一流建设。学校在纺织工程、服装设计与工程、材料科学与工程、设计学、机械工程等学科领域优势显著，形成鲜明的学科特色与办学风格。以「崇德博学，砺志尚实」为校训，承学脉、育英才，致力于培养德才兼备的栋梁之材。校园人文底蕴深厚，教学科研设施完备，是无数学子求学问道、修身立业的理想之地。
scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、上海市外国留学生奖学金、东华大学留学生奖学金
motto_en: Cultivate Virtue, Broaden Learning, Sharpen Will, Value Practice
intro_en: Donghua University, founded in 1951 as China Textile University, is the birthplace of textile higher education in China. The university ranks first nationally in textile science and engineering, and is renowned for its strengths in materials science and design, blending technology with creativity.
admission_en: Donghua University, founded in 1951 as China Textile University, is the birthplace of textile higher education in China. The university ranks first nationally in textile science and engineering, and is renowned for its strengths in materials science and design, blending technology with creativity. Based in Shanghai (Project 211, Double First-Class). The university holds distinctive strengths in Textile Engineering, Apparel Design and Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering, Design, Mechanical Engineering, fostering a characteristic academic tradition. Guided by the motto "Cultivate Virtue, Broaden Learning, Sharpen Will, Value Practice", the university cultivates talent with integrity and excellence. With deep cultural heritage and well-equipped research facilities, the campus is an ideal place for scholars to learn, grow, and pursue their aspirations.
scholarship_en: Chinese Government Scholarship, Shanghai Government Scholarship for International Students, DHU International Student Scholarship

programs_intro.纺织工程: 培养纺织加工技术人才，核心课程含纺织材料学、纺纱学、织造学、纺织品设计，毕业生在纺织企业和纺织研究院工作。
programs_intro.服装设计与工程: 培养服装设计和工程人才，核心课程含服装设计、服装结构、服装工艺、服装材料，毕业生在服装企业和时尚行业工作。
programs_intro.材料科学与工程: 研究材料组成、结构、性能与加工，培养新材料研发人才，涵盖金属材料、无机非金属、高分子材料等方向，毕业生多进入制造业和科研院所。
programs_intro.设计学: 培养综合设计能力人才，涵盖工业设计、视觉传达、环境设计等方向，核心课程含设计史、设计方法、设计表现，毕业生在设计公司广泛就业。
programs_intro.机械工程: 培养掌握机械设计、制造和自动化技术的高级人才，核心课程含机械原理、机械设计、制造技术基础，毕业生在装备制造、汽车、航空航天等领域就业。
programs_intro.工商管理: 培养具备企业管理、市场营销、财务管理能力的综合型人才，核心课程含管理学原理、运营管理、战略管理，毕业生可进入各类企业和咨询机构。

programs_intro_en.纺织工程: Covers fiber science, textile processing, and advanced textile materials. Graduates innovate in fashion, technical textiles, and smart fabrics.
programs_intro_en.服装设计与工程: A specialized program in Apparel Design and Engineering, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.材料科学与工程: Covers metals, ceramics, polymers, nanomaterials, and composite materials. Graduates innovate in aerospace, energy, and advanced manufacturing.
programs_intro_en.设计学: Integrates visual communication, digital design, and creative thinking. Graduates work in UI/UX, branding, advertising, and multimedia design.
programs_intro_en.机械工程: Encompasses mechanical design, robotics, manufacturing, and thermal engineering. Graduates lead innovation in automotive, aerospace, and industrial automation.
programs_intro_en.工商管理: Covers strategy, marketing, operations, and organizational behavior. Prepares future business leaders for multinational corporations and entrepreneurship.

name: 华东理工大学
name_en: East China University of Science and Technology
intro: 华东理工大学创建于1952年，前身为华东化工学院，是中国化工高等教育的先驱。化学工程学科全国领先，工程学进入ESI全球前列。
admission: 华东理工大学创建于1952年，前身为华东化工学院，是中国化工高等教育的先驱。化学工程学科全国领先，工程学进入ESI全球前列。学校全国综合排名位列第45位，211工程、双一流建设。学校在化学工程、高分子材料、生物工程、制药工程、自动化等学科领域优势显著，形成鲜明的学科特色与办学风格。以「勤奋求实，励志明德」为校训，承学脉、育英才，致力于培养德才兼备的栋梁之材。校园人文底蕴深厚，教学科研设施完备，是无数学子求学问道、修身立业的理想之地。
scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、上海市奖学金、ECUST留学生奖学金
motto_en: Diligence, Truth-Seeking, Aspiration, Illustrious Virtue
intro_en: East China University of Science and Technology, founded in 1952 as East China Institute of Chemical Technology, is a pioneer of chemical engineering education in China. The university leads the nation in chemical engineering, with its engineering programs ranked among the global elite.
admission_en: East China University of Science and Technology, founded in 1952 as East China Institute of Chemical Technology, is a pioneer of chemical engineering education in China. The university leads the nation in chemical engineering, with its engineering programs ranked among the global elite. Based in Shanghai (Project 211, Double First-Class). The university holds distinctive strengths in Chemistry, Polymer Materials, Bioengineering, Pharmaceutical Engineering, Automation, fostering a characteristic academic tradition. Guided by the motto "Diligence, Truth-Seeking, Aspiration, Illustrious Virtue", the university cultivates talent with integrity and excellence. With deep cultural heritage and well-equipped research facilities, the campus is an ideal place for scholars to learn, grow, and pursue their aspirations.
scholarship_en: Chinese Government Scholarship, Shanghai Municipal Government Scholarship, ECUST International Student Scholarship

programs_intro.化学工程: 探究物质组成与变化规律，培养具备化学实验和科研能力的人才，涵盖有机化学、无机化学、物理化学等方向，毕业生可从事科研、化工、制药等工作。
programs_intro.高分子材料: 培养高分子材料研发人才，核心课程含高分子化学、高分子物理、高分子材料成型加工，毕业生在材料、化工和制造企业工作。
programs_intro.生物工程: 培养生物技术产业化人才，核心课程含生物化学、微生物学、发酵工程、基因工程，毕业生在生物制药、食品和环保企业工作。
programs_intro.制药工程: 培养药物制造工程人才，核心课程含制药工艺学、药物化学、药剂学、制药设备，毕业生在制药企业从事药品生产和研发工作。
programs_intro.自动化: 以控制论为核心，培养工业自动化、机器人、智能制造领域的高级人才，核心课程含自动控制原理、传感器技术、PLC编程等，就业前景广阔。
programs_intro.环境工程: 培养环境污染治理人才，核心课程含水污染控制工程、大气污染控制工程、固体废物处理、环境监测，毕业生在环保企业和政府部门工作。

programs_intro_en.化学工程: Covers chemical processes, reactor design, and industrial chemistry. Graduates work in petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, and materials manufacturing.
programs_intro_en.高分子材料: A specialized program in Polymer Materials, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.生物工程: Applies engineering principles to biological systems. Covers genetic engineering, fermentation, and bioprocessing for pharmaceuticals and biofuels.
programs_intro_en.制药工程: A specialized program in Pharmaceutical Engineering, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.自动化: Covers control systems, robotics, industrial automation, and intelligent systems. Graduates drive smart manufacturing and Industry 4.0 transformation.
programs_intro_en.环境工程: Focuses on water treatment, air pollution control, waste management, and environmental sustainability. Graduates tackle global environmental challenges.

name: 上海大学
intro: 上海大学创办于1922年，是上海市属重点综合性大学。社会学、美术学、力学等学科优势突出，电影学等新兴学科发展迅速。
admission: 上海大学创办于1922年，是上海市属重点综合性大学。社会学、美术学、力学等学科优势突出，电影学等新兴学科发展迅速。学校全国综合排名位列第50位，211工程、双一流建设。学校在社会学、美术学、机械工程、通信工程、电影学等学科领域优势显著，形成鲜明的学科特色与办学风格。以「自强不息」为校训，承学脉、育英才，致力于培养德才兼备的栋梁之材。校园人文底蕴深厚，教学科研设施完备，是无数学子求学问道、修身立业的理想之地。
scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、上海市奖学金、上海大学留学生奖学金
motto_en: Self-Improvement
intro_en: Shanghai University, founded in 1922, is a key municipal comprehensive university. The university is renowned for its strengths in sociology, fine arts, and mechanics, and has rapidly developed emerging disciplines such as film studies, contributing to Shanghai's cultural and technological vitality.
admission_en: Shanghai University, founded in 1922, is a key municipal comprehensive university. The university is renowned for its strengths in sociology, fine arts, and mechanics, and has rapidly developed emerging disciplines such as film studies, contributing to Shanghai's cultural and technological vitality. Ranked No.50 nationwide, based in Shanghai (Project 211, Double First-Class). The university holds distinctive strengths in Sociology, Fine Arts, Mechanical Engineering, Communication Engineering, Film Studies, fostering a characteristic academic tradition. Guided by the motto "Self-Improvement", the university cultivates talent with integrity and excellence. With deep cultural heritage and well-equipped research facilities, the campus is an ideal place for scholars to learn, grow, and pursue their aspirations.
scholarship_en: Chinese Government Scholarship, Shanghai Municipal Government Scholarship, SHU International Student Scholarship

programs_intro.社会学: 培养具备社会调查与分析能力的人才，核心课程含社会学概论、社会研究方法、社会心理学，毕业生可在政府、NGO、市场研究等领域工作。
programs_intro.美术学: 培养美术研究和创作人才，核心课程含中国美术史、西方美术史、美术理论、绘画创作，毕业生在美术馆、画廊和艺术院校工作。
programs_intro.机械工程: 培养掌握机械设计、制造和自动化技术的高级人才，核心课程含机械原理、机械设计、制造技术基础，毕业生在装备制造、汽车、航空航天等领域就业。
programs_intro.通信工程: 培养通信系统人才，核心课程含通信原理、电磁场与电磁波、无线通信、光纤通信，毕业生在通信设备商和运营商就业。
programs_intro.电影学: 电影学专业培养具备扎实理论基础和较强实践能力的高级专门人才，核心课程涵盖学科前沿理论与技术，毕业生可在相关行业从事技术研发、管理和研究工作。
programs_intro.力学: 研究物体运动与变形规律，培养工程力学计算和分析人才，涵盖固体力学、流体力学、计算力学等方向，毕业生在航空航天、土木、机械等领域就业。

programs_intro_en.社会学: Studies social structures, inequality, and cultural dynamics. Graduates work in research, social policy, NGOs, and international development.
programs_intro_en.美术学: Covers painting, sculpture, calligraphy, and visual arts theory. Graduates become artists, designers, curators, and art educators.
programs_intro_en.机械工程: Encompasses mechanical design, robotics, manufacturing, and thermal engineering. Graduates lead innovation in automotive, aerospace, and industrial automation.
programs_intro_en.通信工程: Focuses on telecommunications, wireless networks, optical fiber, and satellite communication. Prepares engineers for the 5G/6G era.
programs_intro_en.电影学: A specialized program in Film Studies, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.力学: Covers theoretical and applied mechanics, fluid dynamics, and solid mechanics. Graduates work in aerospace, automotive, and engineering design.

name: 上海外国语大学
intro: 上海外国语大学创建于1949年，是新中国外语高等教育的发祥地之一。外国语言文学学科全国领先，开设语种数量居全国前列。
admission: 上海外国语大学创建于1949年，是新中国外语高等教育的发祥地之一。外国语言文学学科全国领先，开设语种数量居全国前列。学校全国综合排名位列第100位，211工程、双一流建设。学校在英语、翻译、国际政治、阿拉伯语、法语等学科领域优势显著，形成鲜明的学科特色与办学风格。以「格高志远，学贯中外」为校训，承学脉、育英才，致力于培养德才兼备的栋梁之材。校园人文底蕴深厚，教学科研设施完备，是无数学子求学问道、修身立业的理想之地。
scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、上海市奖学金、SISU留学生奖学金
motto_en: Noble Character, Lofty Ambition, Mastery of East and West
intro_en: Shanghai International Studies University, founded in 1949, is one of the birthplaces of foreign language higher education in New China. The university leads the nation in foreign language and literature studies, offering one of the widest ranges of language programs in the country.
admission_en: Shanghai International Studies University, founded in 1949, is one of the birthplaces of foreign language higher education in New China. The university leads the nation in foreign language and literature studies, offering one of the widest ranges of language programs in the country. Ranked No.100 nationwide, based in Shanghai (Project 211, Double First-Class). The university holds distinctive strengths in English, Translation, International Politics, Arabic, French, fostering a characteristic academic tradition. Guided by the motto "Noble Character, Lofty Ambition, Mastery of East and West", the university cultivates talent with integrity and excellence. With deep cultural heritage and well-equipped research facilities, the campus is an ideal place for scholars to learn, grow, and pursue their aspirations.
scholarship_en: Chinese Government Scholarship, Shanghai Municipal Government Scholarship, SISU International Student Scholarship

programs_intro.英语: 培养具有扎实英语语言基础和跨文化能力的人才，核心课程含英语精读、英语写作、英美文学、翻译实践，毕业生在外事、教育、外贸等领域就业。
programs_intro.翻译: 培养具备双语转换能力和跨文化素养的翻译人才，核心课程含英汉笔译、口译技巧、翻译理论，毕业生可从事专业翻译、本地化和国际交流工作。
programs_intro.国际政治: 研究国际关系与全球治理，培养具备国际视野和分析能力的人才，核心课程含国际关系理论、外交学、国际法，毕业生可从事外交、国际组织等工作。
programs_intro.阿拉伯语: 培养精通阿拉伯语和阿拉伯文化的专门人才，核心课程含阿拉伯语精读、阿拉伯语视听说、阿拉伯文学，毕业生在外交、经贸、文化交流等领域就业。
programs_intro.法语: 培养精通法语并了解法语区文化的人才，核心课程含法语精读、法语写作、法国文学、翻译实践，毕业生在外事、教育、外贸等领域就业。
programs_intro.西班牙语: 培养精通西班牙语和西语国家文化的人才，核心课程含西班牙语精读、西语国家文学、翻译实践，毕业生在外交、经贸、教育等领域就业。

programs_intro_en.英语: A specialized program in English, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.翻译: A specialized program in Translation, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.国际政治: Focuses on international relations, global governance, and diplomacy. Prepares graduates for careers in foreign service, UN agencies, and global affairs.
programs_intro_en.阿拉伯语: A specialized program in Arabic, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.法语: A specialized program in French, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.西班牙语: A specialized program in Spanish, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.

name: 上海中医药大学
name_en: Shanghai University of Traditional Chinese Medicine
intro: 上海中医药大学创建于1956年，是新中国首批建立的中医药高等院校之一。中医学、中药学、中西医结合等学科全国领先。
admission: 上海中医药大学创建于1956年，是新中国首批建立的中医药高等院校之一。中医学、中药学、中西医结合等学科全国领先。学校全国综合排名位列第100位，211工程、双一流建设。学校在中医学、中药学、针灸推拿学、中西医临床医学、护理学等学科领域优势显著，形成鲜明的学科特色与办学风格。以「勤奋仁爱求实创新」为校训，承学脉、育英才，致力于培养德才兼备的栋梁之材。校园人文底蕴深厚，教学科研设施完备，是无数学子求学问道、修身立业的理想之地。
scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、上海市奖学金、SHUTCM留学生奖学金
motto_en: Diligence, Benevolence, Truth-Seeking, Innovation
intro_en: Shanghai University of Traditional Chinese Medicine, founded in 1956, was among the first Chinese medicine institutions established in New China. The university leads the nation in traditional Chinese medicine, Chinese materia medica, and integrated Chinese-Western medicine, with distinctive Lingnan medical traditions.
admission_en: Shanghai University of Traditional Chinese Medicine, founded in 1956, was among the first Chinese medicine institutions established in New China. The university leads the nation in traditional Chinese medicine, Chinese materia medica, and integrated Chinese-Western medicine, with distinctive Lingnan medical traditions. Ranked No.100 nationwide, based in Shanghai (Project 211, Double First-Class). The university holds distinctive strengths in Traditional Chinese Medicine, Chinese Materia Medica, Acupuncture and Tuina, Integrated Chinese and Western Medicine, Nursing, fostering a characteristic academic tradition. Guided by the motto "Diligence, Benevolence, Truth-Seeking, Innovation", the university cultivates talent with integrity and excellence. With deep cultural heritage and well-equipped research facilities, the campus is an ideal place for scholars to learn, grow, and pursue their aspirations.
scholarship_en: Chinese Government Scholarship, Shanghai Municipal Government Scholarship, SHUTCM International Student Scholarship

programs_intro.中医学: 培养系统掌握中医理论和诊疗技能的人才，核心课程含中医基础理论、中医诊断学、中药学、方剂学，毕业生多进入中医院从事临床工作。
programs_intro.中药学: 培养中药鉴定、炮制和研发人才，核心课程含中药学、中药鉴定学、中药药剂学、中药药理学，毕业生在中药企业、医院药房和科研机构工作。
programs_intro.针灸推拿学: 培养掌握针灸推拿理论和技能的人才，核心课程含经络学、腧穴学、针灸治疗学、推拿手法学，毕业生多在中医院针灸科和康复科工作。
programs_intro.中西医临床医学: 培养中西医结合诊疗人才，核心课程含中医基础理论、西医诊断学、中西医结合内科学，毕业生在中西医结合医院从事临床工作。
programs_intro.护理学: 培养具备临床护理和护理管理能力的人才，核心课程含基础护理学、内科护理学、外科护理学、急救护理学，毕业生在医院和社区卫生机构就业。
programs_intro.康复治疗学: 培养物理治疗和作业治疗人才，核心课程含运动疗法、作业疗法、言语治疗、康复评定学，毕业生在康复中心和医院康复科工作。

programs_intro_en.中医学: Integrates traditional Chinese medicine theory with modern clinical practice. Covers acupuncture, herbal medicine, and diagnostic techniques.
programs_intro_en.中药学: A specialized program in Chinese Materia Medica, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.针灸推拿学: A specialized program in Acupuncture and Tuina, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.中西医临床医学: A specialized program in Integrated Chinese and Western Medicine, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.护理学: Develops clinical nursing skills with emphasis on patient care and health management. Graduates work in hospitals, community health, and international healthcare.
programs_intro_en.康复治疗学: A specialized program in Rehabilitation Therapy, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.

name: 上海音乐学院
intro: 上海音乐学院创建于1927年，前身为国立音乐院，是中国第一所独立建制的音乐学院。音乐与舞蹈学学科全国第一。
admission: 上海音乐学院创建于1927年，前身为国立音乐院，是中国第一所独立建制的音乐学院。音乐与舞蹈学学科全国第一。学校全国综合排名位列第150位，211工程、双一流建设。学校在音乐表演、作曲与作曲技术理论、音乐学、指挥、录音艺术等学科领域优势显著，形成鲜明的学科特色与办学风格。以「和毅庄诚」为校训，承学脉、育英才，致力于培养德才兼备的栋梁之材。校园人文底蕴深厚，教学科研设施完备，是无数学子求学问道、修身立业的理想之地。
scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、上海市奖学金、SHCM留学生奖学金
motto_en: Harmony, Perseverance, Dignity, Sincerity
intro_en: The Shanghai Conservatory of Music, founded in 1927 as the National Conservatory of Music, was China's first independent music institution. The university ranks first nationally in music and dance studies, and has produced many of China's most distinguished musicians and composers.
admission_en: The Shanghai Conservatory of Music, founded in 1927 as the National Conservatory of Music, was China's first independent music institution. programs_intro.机械工程: 培养掌握机械设计、制造和自动化技术的高级人才，核心课程含机械原理、机械设计、制造技术基础，毕业生在装备制造、汽车、航空航天等领域就业。
programs_intro.交通运输工程: 培养交通系统规划运营人才，核心课程含交通运输学、交通规划、交通工程设计、物流工程，毕业生在交通部门和运输企业工作。
programs_intro.汽车工程: 汽车工程专业培养具备扎实理论基础和较强实践能力的高级专门人才，核心课程涵盖学科前沿理论与技术，毕业生可在相关行业从事技术研发、管理和研究工作。
programs_intro.设计学: 培养综合设计能力人才，涵盖工业设计、视觉传达、环境设计等方向，核心课程含设计史、设计方法、设计表现，毕业生在设计公司广泛就业。

programs_intro_en.船舶与海洋工程: Covers naval architecture, marine engineering, and offshore structures. Graduates design ships, submarines, and offshore platforms.
programs_intro_en.机械工程: Encompasses mechanical design, robotics, manufacturing, and thermal engineering. Graduates lead innovation in automotive, aerospace, and industrial automation.
programs_intro_en.交通运输工程: A specialized program in Transportation Engineering, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.汽车工程: A specialized program in Automotive Engineering, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.设计学: Integrates visual communication, digital design, and creative thinking. Graduates work in UI/UX, branding, advertising, and multimedia design.

name: 中国地质大学（武汉）
intro: 中国地质大学（武汉）创建于1952年，前身为北京地质学院，是地质类学科的顶尖学府。地质学、地质资源与地质工程全国第一。

scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、湖北省奖学金、CUG留学生奖学金

programs_intro.地质学: 研究地球物质组成与演化历史，培养地质调查和资源勘探人才，涵盖矿物学、岩石学、构造地质学等课程，毕业生在地质调查、矿业、能源等领域就业。

programs_intro.石油工程: 培养油气田开发人才，核心课程含油藏工程、钻井工程、采油工程、油田化学，毕业生在石油企业和油气田研究院工作。
programs_intro.海洋科学: 海洋科学专业培养具备扎实理论基础和较强实践能力的高级专门人才，核心课程涵盖学科前沿理论与技术，毕业生可在相关行业从事技术研发、管理和研究工作。
programs_intro.珠宝首饰设计: 珠宝首饰设计专业培养具备扎实理论基础和较强实践能力的高级专门人才，核心课程涵盖学科前沿理论与技术，毕业生可在相关行业从事技术研发、管理和研究工作。

programs_intro_en.地质学: Studies Earth's materials, structures, and processes. Graduates work in mineral exploration, environmental geology, and geotechnical engineering.
programs_intro_en.资源勘查工程: A specialized program in Resource Exploration Engineering, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.地球物理学: Explores Earth's interior structure, seismic activity, and geophysical exploration. Graduates work in resource exploration, earthquake monitoring, and research.
programs_intro_en.石油工程: A specialized program in Petroleum Engineering, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.海洋科学: Explores oceanography, marine biology, and marine resources. Graduates contribute to marine conservation, resource management, and climate science.
programs_intro_en.珠宝首饰设计: A specialized program in Jewelry and Accessories Design, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.

programs_intro.政治学: 培养政治理论和行政管理人才，核心课程含政治学原理、行政管理学、公共政策、中国政治制度，毕业生在党政机关和事业单位工作。

programs_intro_en.教育学: Covers teaching methodology, educational psychology, and curriculum design. Graduates become educators, administrators, and education policy specialists.
programs_intro_en.政治学: Explores political theory, comparative politics, and international relations. Graduates work in diplomacy, government, think tanks, and international organizations.
programs_intro_en.中国语言文学: A specialized program in Chinese Language and Literature, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.心理学: Explores cognitive, developmental, social, and clinical psychology. Graduates work in mental health, education, HR, and research.
programs_intro_en.历史学: Explores Chinese and world history through archival research and critical analysis. Graduates pursue academia, museums, cultural heritage, and public policy.
programs_intro_en.物理学: Explores fundamental laws of nature from quantum mechanics to cosmology. Graduates pursue research, teaching, and high-tech industry roles globally.

programs_intro_en.畜牧学: A specialized program in Animal Husbandry, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.兽医学: A specialized program in Veterinary Medicine, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.

admission_en: Southwestern University of Finance and Economics, rooted in Guanghua University of 1925, is a key finance and economics university under the Ministry of Education. Known as 'China's financial talent pool,' the university is renowned for its strengths in finance and accounting. Ranked No.70 nationwide, based in Sichuan (Project 211, Double First-Class). The university holds distinctive strengths in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Insurance, fostering a characteristic academic tradition. Guided by the motto "Rigor, Diligence, Thrift, Truth-Seeking, Pioneering", the university cultivates talent with integrity and excellence. With deep cultural heritage and well-equipped research facilities, the campus is an ideal place for scholars to learn, grow, and pursue their aspirations.
scholarship_en: Chinese Government Scholarship, Sichuan Provincial Government Scholarship, SWUFE International Student Scholarship

programs_intro.金融学: 培养掌握金融理论和金融市场运作能力的人才，核心课程含货币银行学、国际金融、投资学、金融工程，毕业生在银行、证券、基金等金融机构就业。
programs_intro.会计学: 培养系统掌握会计理论和实务技能的专业人才，核心课程含财务会计、管理会计、审计学、税法，毕业生多进入会计师事务所和企业财务部门。
programs_intro.经济学: 研究资源配置与经济发展规律，培养具备经济分析和决策能力的人才，涵盖宏观经济学、微观经济学、计量经济学，毕业生多进入金融和政府部门。
programs_intro.工商管理: 培养具备企业管理、市场营销、财务管理能力的综合型人才，核心课程含管理学原理、运营管理、战略管理，毕业生可进入各类企业和咨询机构。
programs_intro.保险学: 培养具备风险评估和保险经营管理能力的人才，核心课程含保险学原理、财产保险、人身保险、精算学，毕业生多进入保险公司和保险监管机构。
programs_intro.财务管理: 培养企业财务管理人才，核心课程含财务管理学、成本管理、投资学、财务分析，毕业生在企业财务部门和会计师事务所工作。

programs_intro_en.金融学: Focuses on investment, risk management, corporate finance, and financial markets. Graduates work at banks, investment firms, and fintech companies.
programs_intro_en.会计学: Covers financial reporting, auditing, taxation, and management accounting. Graduates become CPAs and financial professionals at top firms.
programs_intro_en.经济学: Covers micro/macroeconomics, econometrics, and international trade. Graduates pursue careers in finance, consulting, government, and international organizations.
programs_intro_en.工商管理: Covers strategy, marketing, operations, and organizational behavior. Prepares future business leaders for multinational corporations and entrepreneurship.
programs_intro_en.保险学: A specialized program in Insurance, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.财务管理: A specialized program in Financial Management, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.

name: 四川农业大学
motto: 追求真理，造福社会，自强不息
intro: 四川农业大学源于1906年四川通省农业学堂，是一所以生物科技为特色的高等农业学府。作物学、畜牧学、林学等学科优势突出。
admission: 四川农业大学源于1906年四川通省农业学堂，是一所以生物科技为特色的高等农业学府。作物学、畜牧学、林学等学科优势突出。学校全国综合排名位列第120位，211工程、双一流建设。学校在作物学、畜牧学、兽医学、林学、园艺学等学科领域优势显著，形成鲜明的学科特色与办学风格。以「追求真理，造福社会，自强不息」为校训，承学脉、育英才，致力于培养德才兼备的栋梁之材。校园人文底蕴深厚，教学科研设施完备，是无数学子求学问道、修身立业的理想之地。
scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、四川省奖学金、SAU留学生奖学金
motto_en: Pursue Truth, Benefit Society, Self-Improvement
intro_en: Sichuan Agricultural University, rooted in Sichuan Agricultural School of 1906, is a higher agricultural institution distinguished by biotechnology. The university is renowned for its strengths in crop science, animal husbandry, and forestry, and serves as a key research center for agricultural science.
admission_en: Sichuan Agricultural University, rooted in Sichuan Agricultural School of 1906, is a higher agricultural institution distinguished by biotechnology. The university is renowned for its strengths in crop science, animal husbandry, and forestry, and serves as a key research center for agricultural science. Ranked No.120 nationwide, based in Sichuan (Project 211, Double First-Class). The university holds distinctive strengths in Crop Science, Animal Husbandry, Veterinary Medicine, Forestry, Horticulture, fostering a characteristic academic tradition. Guided by the motto "Pursue Truth, Benefit Society, Self-Improvement", the university cultivates talent with integrity and excellence. With deep cultural heritage and well-equipped research facilities, the campus is an ideal place for scholars to learn, grow, and pursue their aspirations.
scholarship_en: Chinese Government Scholarship, Sichuan Provincial Government Scholarship, SAU International Student Scholarship

programs_intro.作物学: 研究作物高产优质栽培与育种，培养农业科研和技术人才，涵盖作物栽培学、作物育种学、种子学等方向，毕业生多在农科院和种业公司工作。
programs_intro.畜牧学: 培养动物生产和育种人才，核心课程含动物遗传学、动物营养学、动物繁殖学，毕业生在畜牧企业和养殖场从事技术管理工作。
programs_intro.兽医学: 培养动物疾病诊疗和防疫人才，核心课程含动物解剖学、兽医病理学、兽医微生物学，毕业生在兽医站、宠物医院和养殖企业工作。
programs_intro.林学: 培养森林培育和保护人才，核心课程含树木学、森林生态学、林木育种学、森林经理学，毕业生在林业部门、森林公园和自然保护区工作。
programs_intro.园艺学: 培养园艺作物栽培和育种人才，核心课程含果树学、蔬菜学、观赏园艺学、园艺植物育种，毕业生在园艺企业和农业部门工作。
programs_intro.农业资源与环境: 培养农业资源高效利用和环境保护人才，核心课程含土壤学、植物营养学、环境监测，毕业生在农业、环保、国土等部门就业。

programs_intro_en.作物学: A specialized program in Crop Science, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.畜牧学: A specialized program in Animal Husbandry, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.兽医学: A specialized program in Veterinary Medicine, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.林学: A specialized program in Forestry, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.园艺学: A specialized program in Horticulture, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.农业资源与环境: A specialized program in Agricultural Resources and Environment, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.

name: 暨南大学
intro: 暨南大学创办于1906年，是中国第一所由国家创办的华侨高等学府，被誉为「华侨最高学府」。新闻传播学、应用经济学等学科国内领先。
admission: 暨南大学创办于1906年，是中国第一所由国家创办的华侨高等学府，被誉为「华侨最高学府」。新闻传播学、应用经济学等学科国内领先。学校全国综合排名位列第60位，211工程、双一流建设。学校在新闻传播学、应用经济学、中国语言文学、生物医学工程、工商管理等学科领域优势显著，形成鲜明的学科特色与办学风格。以「忠信笃敬」为校训，承学脉、育英才，致力于培养德才兼备的栋梁之材。校园人文底蕴深厚，教学科研设施完备，是无数学子求学问道、修身立业的理想之地。
scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、广东省政府奖学金、JNU留学生奖学金
motto_en: Loyalty, Faith, Dedication, Reverence
intro_en: Jinan University, founded in 1906, was China's first state-established university for overseas Chinese students. Widely acclaimed as the 'premier university for overseas Chinese,' it is renowned for its strengths in journalism and communication, applied economics, and Chinese language and literature.
admission_en: Jinan University, founded in 1906, was China's first state-established university for overseas Chinese students. Widely acclaimed as the 'premier university for overseas Chinese,' it is renowned for its strengths in journalism and communication, applied economics, and Chinese language and literature. Ranked No.60 nationwide, based in Guangdong (Project 211, Double First-Class). Guided by the motto "Loyalty, Faith, Dedication, Reverence", the university cultivates talent with integrity and excellence. With deep cultural heritage and well-equipped research facilities, the campus is an ideal place for scholars to learn, grow, and pursue their aspirations.

programs_intro.新闻传播学: 培养具备新闻采编、传播策划和新媒体运营能力的人才，涵盖新闻采访、传播学理论、媒介经营管理等课程，毕业生多进入媒体和互联网行业。
programs_intro.应用经济学: 培养运用经济理论解决实际问题的复合型人才，核心课程含计量经济学、金融学、产业经济学，毕业生可在金融、政府、企业等部门从事经济分析工作。
programs_intro.中国语言文学: 深入研究汉语言文字与中国文学，培养具备深厚人文素养的人才，涵盖古代文学、现代文学、语言学等方向，毕业生多从事教育、文化、传媒工作。
programs_intro.生物医学工程: 培养医学与工程交叉人才，核心课程含生物医学信号处理、医学图像、生物材料、医疗仪器，毕业生在医疗器械企业和医院工作。
programs_intro.工商管理: 培养具备企业管理、市场营销、财务管理能力的综合型人才，核心课程含管理学原理、运营管理、战略管理，毕业生可进入各类企业和咨询机构。
programs_intro.药学: 培养药物研发、生产和应用人才，核心课程含药物化学、药剂学、药理学、药物分析，毕业生在制药企业、医院药房和药检部门工作。

programs_intro_en.新闻传播学: Covers journalism, digital media, public relations, and communication theory. Graduates work in media, corporate communications, and content creation.
programs_intro_en.应用经济学: A specialized program in Applied Economics, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.中国语言文学: A specialized program in Chinese Language and Literature, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.生物医学工程: Interdisciplinary program combining engineering with medicine. Covers medical devices, imaging, biomaterials, and rehabilitation engineering.
programs_intro_en.工商管理: Covers strategy, marketing, operations, and organizational behavior. Prepares future business leaders for multinational corporations and entrepreneurship.
programs_intro_en.药学: Covers drug discovery, pharmacology, pharmaceutical chemistry, and clinical pharmacy. Graduates work in pharmaceutical R&D, hospitals, and regulatory agencies.

name: 华南师范大学
motto: 艰苦奋斗，严谨治学，求实创新，为人师表
intro: 华南师范大学创建于1933年，是广东省属重点师范大学。心理学、教育学、物理学等学科国内领先。
admission: 华南师范大学创建于1933年，是广东省属重点师范大学。心理学、教育学、物理学等学科国内领先。学校全国综合排名位列第80位，211工程、双一流建设。学校在教育学、心理学、物理学、数学、中国语言文学等学科领域优势显著，形成鲜明的学科特色与办学风格。以「艰苦奋斗，严谨治学，求实创新，为人师表」为校训，承学脉、育英才，致力于培养德才兼备的栋梁之材。校园人文底蕴深厚，教学科研设施完备，是无数学子求学问道、修身立业的理想之地。
scholarship: 中国政府奖学金、广东省政府奖学金、SCNU留学生奖学金
motto_en: Hard Work, Rigorous Scholarship, Truth-Seeking, Innovation, Exemplary Conduct
intro_en: South China Normal University, founded in 1933, is a key provincial normal university in Guangdong. The university is renowned for its strengths in psychology, education, and physics, and is a leading institution for teacher education and educational research in southern China.
admission_en: South China Normal University, founded in 1933, is a key provincial normal university in Guangdong. The university is renowned for its strengths in psychology, education, and physics, and is a leading institution for teacher education and educational research in southern China. Ranked No.80 nationwide, based in Guangdong (Project 211, Double First-Class). The university holds distinctive strengths in Education, Psychology, Physics, Mathematics, Chinese Language and Literature, fostering a characteristic academic tradition. Guided by the motto "Hard Work, Rigorous Scholarship, Truth-Seeking, Innovation, Exemplary Conduct", the university cultivates talent with integrity and excellence. With deep cultural heritage and well-equipped research facilities, the campus is an ideal place for scholars to learn, grow, and pursue their aspirations.
scholarship_en: Chinese Government Scholarship, Guangdong Provincial Government Scholarship, SCNU International Student Scholarship

programs_intro.教育学: 培养教育理论和教学实践能力兼备的人才，核心课程含教育学原理、课程与教学论、教育心理学，毕业生多从事教育教学和教育管理工作。
programs_intro.心理学: 研究人类心理与行为规律，培养心理咨询和研究人才，涵盖认知心理学、发展心理学、临床心理学等方向，毕业生可从事心理咨询、教育、人力资源等工作。
programs_intro.物理学: 探究物质基本规律，培养具备理论物理和实验物理能力的人才，核心课程含量子力学、电动力学、统计物理，毕业生可从事科研、教育及高新技术产业。
programs_intro.数学: 培养具有坚实数学基础和逻辑思维能力的人才，核心课程含数学分析、高等代数、拓扑学，毕业生可在教育、金融、数据科学等领域发展。
programs_intro.中国语言文学: 深入研究汉语言文字与中国文学，培养具备深厚人文素养的人才，涵盖古代文学、现代文学、语言学等方向，毕业生多从事教育、文化、传媒工作。
programs_intro.体育学: 体育学专业培养具备扎实理论基础和较强实践能力的高级专门人才，核心课程涵盖学科前沿理论与技术，毕业生可在相关行业从事技术研发、管理和研究工作。

programs_intro_en.教育学: Covers teaching methodology, educational psychology, and curriculum design. Graduates become educators, administrators, and education policy specialists.
programs_intro_en.心理学: Explores cognitive, developmental, social, and clinical psychology. Graduates work in mental health, education, HR, and research.
programs_intro_en.物理学: Explores fundamental laws of nature from quantum mechanics to cosmology. Graduates pursue research, teaching, and high-tech industry roles globally.
programs_intro_en.数学: A specialized program in Mathematics, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.中国语言文学: A specialized program in Chinese Language and Literature, covering core theories and practical applications. Graduates pursue careers in research, industry, and academia.
programs_intro_en.体育学: Combines sports science, physical education, and athletic training. Graduates work in sports management, coaching, and health promotion.

name: 广州中医药大学
intro: 广州中医药大学创建于1956年，是新中国首批建立的中医药高等院校之一。中医学、中药学等学科国内领先，岭南医学特色鲜明。
